Device.description: The network interface to capture packets from. This field is required.

BPF.description: The Berkeley Packet Filter (BPF) expression to filter packets. Default is 'port 53'.

Direction.description: Specifies the packet direction to capture: 'in', 'out', or 'inout'. Default is 'inout'.

ResolverQueryEnabled.description: Enable or disable processing of resolver queries.

ResolverResponseEnabled.description: Enable or disable processing of resolver responses.

ClientQueryEnabled.description: Enable or disable processing of client queries.

ClientResponseEnabled.description: Enable or disable processing of client responses.

WorkerNum.description: The number of workers to process packets concurrently. Must be greater than or equal to 1. Default is 1.
